fields.acceptance: A testscript with seeded run journals and RHIZA_TEST_NOW checks rhiza run ls --json's order, fields and --limit, and its human output; describe-golden.txtar is regenerated
fields.statement: A run.ls operation lists the repository's runs newest first with each run's ID, change set, title, state, current step, start time and whether it is live, limited by --limit

fields.acceptance: A Go test in internal/tui/liveapp over a fake runner with canned daemon.status, run.ls and run.status results and an injected clock asserts the view's title, step, leaves count, check outcomes and elapsed time, and that a tick with changed results updates the view keeping the cursor on the same run; a testscript checks rhiza tui app live --once prints run.ls's JSON, and the app is in the launcher registry
fields.statement: A live app, registered as a Rex app, shows the daemon's state and each live or recent run with its change set title, current step, leaves passed of total, checks and elapsed time, refreshing every 3 seconds

fields.acceptance: A Go test with a fake runner: enter calls run.open with the row's change set, opened true shows focused and tab_gone true shows tab gone; enter on a finished run calls nothing
fields.statement: Enter on a live run in the live app focuses its Rex tab, and the app says so when the run has no live tab

fields.acceptance: A test in internal/tui/roadmapapp opens the detail with a fake run.status saying running, changes it to succeeded, sends the tick and asserts the run section updated without calling change.show again; a tick in the list view calls no run.status
fields.statement: While the roadmap app's detail view is open it reloads its latest-run section every 3 seconds
